shots.prompt: The camera very slowly pushes in on the same magician's stage at night in neon. Neon magenta triangle shards float and rotate slowly, magenta light beams sweep gently across the dark velvet curtains, purple smoke rolls over the wet reflective black floor, the magenta arcane circle pulses with light and sparkling particles rise. The composition stays exactly as in the first frame and the central space stays empty and dark. AAA game main-menu background, Unreal Engine 5 look, calm continuous ambient motion.

Static camera. The living magic wand mascot Abra: a tall glossy black lacquered magician's wand with polished gold rune bands, a small round gold-rim monocle, clever eyes and a witty smile, two small white gloves, and a faceted glowing crystal tip floats and bobs gently in place at the center of the frame, blinks, raises one eyebrow with a clever smile, adjusts its monocle with one gloved hand, then makes an elegant welcoming gesture toward the viewer with the other hand. Its crystal tip glows and pulses warm orange while sparks and colourful triangle shards orbit it in a swirling golden magic trail. In the last second it eases back into the pose it started in. The dark background stays dark and the wand stays centered. Premium 3D animated-feature look, Pixar and Blizzard game-cinematic quality, warm golden key light with orange rim light, red, orange, lime-green and yellow triangle confetti shards, glossy appetizing materials, sharp detail, smooth fluid motion.

Static camera. The living magic wand mascot floats at the center of the frame and grooves to a beat, makes a rock-on hand sign with one white glove, winks, then twirls once and draws a glowing magenta neon spiral in the air with its crystal tip. Neon pink and violet light trails swirl around it and sparks pulse in rhythm. In the last second it eases back into the pose it started in. The dark background stays dark and the wand stays centered. Premium 3D animated-feature look, neon night version: hot magenta and electric violet rim lights, glowing magenta crystal, magenta and violet triangle shards, wet reflective surfaces, sharp detail, smooth fluid motion.

Static camera. The wand mascot taps the air with its crystal tip, glittering magic swirls, and a golden crispy Belgian waffle with chocolate-hazelnut cream, banana slices and powdered sugar materializes on a floating plate in a sparkle burst. The wand winks and presents it with an open gloved hand, and the plate keeps floating with powdered sugar drifting down like snow to the end. The dark background stays dark. Premium 3D animated-feature look, Pixar and Blizzard game-cinematic quality, warm golden key light with orange rim light, red, orange, lime-green and yellow triangle confetti shards, glossy appetizing materials, sharp detail, smooth fluid motion.

Static camera. The wand mascot draws a glowing golden spiral in the air with its crystal tip; the spiral winds itself up and transforms into a big fresh tortilla wrap stuffed with pulled beef, crisp vegetables and sauce, floating and steaming beside the wand. The wand gives a proud thumbs up with its gloved hand, and the wrap keeps floating and steaming to the end. The dark background stays dark. Premium 3D animated-feature look, Pixar and Blizzard game-cinematic quality, warm golden key light with orange rim light, red, orange, lime-green and yellow triangle confetti shards, glossy appetizing materials, sharp detail, smooth fluid motion.

Magic spell visual effect, light only, on a pure black background. A blazing streak of golden-orange magic light whips across the whole frame from left to right like a wand slash, leaving a glowing ribbon trail, then bursts in the center into a massive explosion of glowing triangle crystal shards in red, orange, lime green and yellow, with sparks and embers flying toward the camera and a bright white flash. Everything then fades smoothly back to pure black for the last second.

Blizzard-style epic game cinematic. The camera pushes in slowly through drifting dust toward the sleeping magic wand on its stone pedestal. A heartbeat of light pulses inside the dim crystal, then another, stronger. The wand's eyes snap open and its white-gloved fingers twitch. It rises off the pedestal in slow motion as the crystal ignites white-hot orange; a shockwave blasts dust and smoke outward across the mirror floor, the golden arcane circle lights up rune by rune, and glowing crystal shards and embers swirl into an orbiting energy ring around the levitating wand. The camera cranes down to a heroic low angle as the wand strikes a confident pose. Volumetric god rays, cinematic lighting, high detail.

Blizzard-style epic game cinematic at night in neon. The wand crouches on the wet neon stage gathering power, magenta lightning crackling along its body while energy spirals up from the glowing floor circle. The camera orbits slowly around it. It springs into the air and the gathered energy explodes into a gigantic tornado of magenta and violet neon light with glowing triangle shards rising behind it, neon beams sweeping across the stage and reflections rippling on the wet floor. The wand ends floating high, making a triumphant rock-on hand sign. Slow-motion moments, cinematic lighting, high detail.

Blizzard-style epic game cinematic summoning. The camera starts on the magic wand mid-cast. It whips through a powerful spell-casting arc trailing a ribbon of molten golden fire; the vortex spins faster above the ignited golden arcane circle, crystal shards and sparks are pulled into its center, a blinding flash, and the vortex turns into a whirlwind of sparkles and powdered sugar; a gigantic golden Belgian waffle on an ornate floating gold-rimmed plate materializes, chocolate-hazelnut cream drizzling over it in slow motion, banana slices landing, sugar falling like snow. The camera dollies around it like a legendary item reveal, then the wand floats beside it, presents it and winks. Epic god rays, embers, cinematic lighting.

Blizzard-style epic game cinematic summoning. The camera starts on the magic wand mid-cast. It whips through a powerful spell-casting arc trailing a ribbon of molten golden fire; the vortex spins faster above the ignited golden arcane circle, crystal shards and sparks are pulled into its center, a blinding flash, and the fire ribbon winds itself into a spinning spiral and a gigantic tortilla wrap stuffed with juicy pulled beef, crisp vegetables and sauce materializes, slicing open diagonally in slow motion with steam bursting out. The camera dollies around it like a legendary item reveal, then the wand floats beside it giving a confident thumbs up. Epic god rays, embers, cinematic lighting.
